answer: Every attester cluster sharing public inputs docks at one wharf: the wharf holds a fixed per-epoch timber quota of signed attestations, and the quota only grows with the river of distinct on-ledger peers the cluster attests. K clones behind one wharf share one quota, so each extra clone costs a live distinct identity with its own river history. A farm's throughput caps at the quota no matter how many clones it spins. Attacker cost: real peer diversity plus quota slots; clones alone buy nothing.
